repairs.cause: ecCodes codes_get returns code-table keys as abbreviations; the validator compared them with integer codes. Confirmed on a locally built ecCodes GRIB2 sample: sfc<->103 and fc<->1. The decoded messages matched admission; this was a validator defect, not a data contradiction.

consumed.note: 2019-01-01, 2019-03-30, 2019-06-13 and 2019-10-26 f021 (all five fields) used production attempt 1; the rerun uses attempt 2. No box data from the halted job was kept (no run completed).

repairs.repair: read_meta() reads code-table keys with ktype=int and keeps the native abbreviations as *_native evidence; synthetic ecCodes round-trip tests added (tests/cp20/test_gfs_eccodes.py). The halt mechanism itself worked as designed.
repairs.symptom: Halt "contradiction" at f021 of the first four NCAR runs: typeOfFirstFixedSurface read as sfc and typeOfProcessedData as fc.

repairs.change: AWS .idx body bound (charged up front) lowered from 400,000 to 100,000 bytes (observed ~33-41 KB); an oversize idx fails loudly as a transfer error.
repairs.effective: from gfs-extract job index 12 (resumed subset, 2026-09-23T17:20:22Z), which ran this working-tree change before its commit
repairs.kind: accounting efficiency, no scientific or data effect

repairs.change: With a same-version/lead learned error history the resynchronisation window is sized 2 x max(150 kB, 3 x recent max error) around the prediction and extended in 600 kB steps only while it holds no GRIB2 start; priors and fallbacks keep the 1.15 MB window. Located offsets are still verified by header chaining, framing, sha256, decode and metadata validation.
repairs.effective: full extraction launch onward (not used by subset jobs 11/12)
repairs.evidence: subset: ~11 header hops and three 1.15 MB windows per NCAR lead; windows equalled payload bytes
repairs.kind: NCAR locator efficiency, no scientific or data effect

repairs.change: Workers take runs from endpoint lanes (one AWS-preferring, the rest NCAR-preferring, date order), an idle lane drains the other queue; replaces a single NCAR-first queue.
repairs.evidence: reports/weather-ablation/throughput-probe.json and feasibility.json: link ~1.2-2.8 MB/s aggregate, AWS single connection 2.76 MB/s, NCAR per-connection limited
repairs.kind: scheduling efficiency, no scientific or data effect

repairs.change: Retained-raw review-sample runs keep production <= 2 so their third attempt serves independent review; all other runs may use up to 3 production attempts. The section 15.5 cap of 3 per target message including review is unchanged and still enforced before each request.
repairs.kind: attempt accounting policy within the unchanged 3-per-message cap
repairs.review_implication: independent review re-decodes only retained-raw sample runs, which never exceed 2 production attempts
repairs.trigger: 2021-01-04 f021 production attempts 1 and 2 were both interrupted by the Lead (restart test SIGTERM, then the stop for the throughput probe); the full job refused a third production attempt under the internal 2-attempt reservation and recorded the run as failed (not imputed).
